findings.reason: without naming the retained kernel the two implementation nodes will write a second GMRES inside `solve.py` and the working one dies with the old module, which is the parallel-owner drift the retirement is meant to prevent.
findings.text: the plan deletes `fixed_point.py` wholesale and proposes `solve.fixed_point` as "Newton-GMRES on the map's own JVP" applied "at one call site served from a `lax.scan`", but the generic GMRES kernel (`_gmres_classical_gram_schmidt`, `_gmres_lstsq`, `_gmres_restart_start`, `_gmres_dot`, `:2185`) and the fixed-capacity scan solver state machine (`_NewtonIterationState:552`, `_NewtonGlobalizationState:590`, the outer `jax.lax.scan` at `:4955`) already live in `fixed_point.py` and are exactly that mechanism; the design's only retention clause is the blanket "linear-algebra helpers can remain private dependencies", which never names the GMRES kernel or says where it moves once `fixed_point.py` is deleted

findings.reason: two receipts for one solve will diverge on exactly the fields the §5 "history agrees with the terminal receipt" clause tests, so the design should extend `ForwardSolveReceipt` or state why per-step granularity cannot live in the existing owner.
findings.text: `ForwardSolveReceipt` already owns the per-step solve history (`residual_history:637`, `mask_history:638`, `amplitude_history:640`) and is the declared host-facing serialization seam, yet the design defines a new `SolveResult` carrying its own "fixed-capacity history" and "one history record per accepted Newton step" plus a separately recorded initial/stop state, without citing `solve_request.py` as the owner to extend

findings.reason: the ambitious compile-cost clauses are the least-likely-to-hold part of the plan and rebuilding a meter in the test file will produce a second, weaker instrument that does not reconcile with the archived StableHLO/executable-size receipts, whereas extending the existing profiler makes the numbers comparable on day one.
findings.text: the compile-cost clauses of §6 (`test_one_program_per_shape`, `test_executable_size`, `test_cold_compile_wall`, `test_cold_compile_host_memory`, `test_single_operator_body` via optimized HLO) describe a compile/reuse meter that already exists: `measure.py`'s `profile-gpu` "runs the fixed-shape ten-Newton, thirty-GMRES solver on a CUDA device... records... the compiled StableHLO from which loop trip counts are extracted", alongside `scripts/device_kernel_port/measure_unpaired_compile.py` and the reuse map `scripts/accuracy_cost_ladder`/`scripts/device_kernel_reuse/reuse-report.md`; the design cites neither and proposes fresh test identities

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — four module-qualified functions (`topology.read`, `current.book`, `gs.apply`, `solve.fixed_point`) each hide substantial behaviour (contour-tree kernel on the wall-clipped hex carrier, sub-cell axis-connected fragment connectivity, augmented Newton/GMRES/line-search on the live composed map, and the implicit binder derivative) behind a single signature and one pytree result; the surface is smaller than what it conceals and the design does not spread the complexity across parallel small wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan retires three existing mechanisms (`fixed_point.py`'s GMRES/Newton-scan kernels, the `ForwardSolveReceipt` history, and the `scripts/` compile/reuse instrument) and re-creates each in a new module (`solve.py`, a new `SolveResult` receipt, new `test_cold_compile_*`/`test_one_program_per_shape` meters) without naming the existing owner to extend; each is emitted as a finding below.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the design performed and cited a genuine search of `nova/equilibrium`: 17 null-role and 23 region-role inventory rows, each carrying a real source binding, all four interface components bind to a named existing mechanism, and every marker I spot-checked resolves (`topology.py:1125 read_qualification`, `contour_tree.py:384 build_contour_tree`, `stencil_mesh.py:449 flux_field_polynomial`, `forward_operator.py:830 _FixedDesignNull2D` and `:2323 class ForwardFluxOperator`, `fixed_point.py:4410 _active_set_newton_krylov`, `clip_quadrature.py:714 clipped_support_current_moments`); it cites the retained tests and instruments it extends and explicitly distinguishes generators from consumers. Its one search gap — the `scripts/` instrumentation that owns compile/reuse measurement — is carried as a duplicate_owner finding below.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the design gives an explicit extend-vs-wrap reason for each component rather than defaulting to a wrapper: `gs.apply` "replaces the map `ForwardFluxOperator` performs today rather than wrapping it"; chord is declared "a quadrature degree of the same function" of the one booking, not a second route; the plan's §6 states `topology.py` "is replaced in place". No component is added as a pass-through over machinery that could instead be extended.
